spec.title: Interactive Dashboard Application with Flask Backend
spec.summary: A production‑ready interactive dashboard powered by a Flask backend serving dynamic chart data via REST APIs. The UI uses HTML5, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript to render charts, tables, and filters, with a Jinja2 template for the main page. The project includes automated tests verifying API responses, page rendering, and data integrity.

files.name: app.py
files.purpose: Initializes the Flask application, defines RESTful endpoints for dashboard metrics, serves the main template, and handles server configuration and error handling.

files.purpose: Lists required Python packages for the Flask app.
